narrative.summary: The Dominican Republic steers AI through its National Artificial Intelligence Strategy (ENIA), launched in October 2023 and made binding on Executive Branch planning by Decree 498-23; the Innovation and Digital Development Cabinet and the government ICT office (OGTIC) lead its implementation. The 2013 personal data protection law (Law 172-13) is the general data protection baseline. AI bills in Congress, an AI ethics code and an update of the data protection law are all still pending.
lead_institutions: Oficina Gubernamental de Tecnologías de la Información y Comunicación (OGTIC)
Gabinete de Innovación y Desarrollo Digital
narrative.review_notes: This review was carried out on 12 October 2026 from documents read in full on official sites. The legal database's search and Congress's bill-tracking pages could not be used, so the pending AI bills and an announced AI ethics code are tracked as leads.

instruments.official_title: Decreto núm. 498-23 que aprueba la Estrategia Nacional de Inteligencia Artificial (ENIA) y su plan de acción
instruments.english_title: Decree No. 498-23 approving the National Artificial Intelligence Strategy (ENIA) and its action plan
instruments.issuing_authority: President of the Dominican Republic (Executive Branch)
instruments.current_status: Signed by President Luis Abinader in Santo Domingo on 11 October 2023 and launched with the strategy the same day; the decree states no separate entry-into-force date and no Gaceta Oficial reference is printed on the signed text. The ENIA it approves is valid until 31 December 2030 and may be updated annually by the Innovation and Digital Development Cabinet; no amending decree was found.
instruments.summary: Presidential decree that approves the National AI Strategy (ENIA) and its action plan, valid until 31 December 2030 and implemented through action plans run by the Innovation and Digital Development Cabinet. It sets three pillars (Smart Government, covering AI governance and ethics, AI in public administration and public-private partnerships; a Human Talent and Innovation Hub; and a Data Hub for AI computing infrastructure) plus a cross-cutting regional pillar. It obliges all Executive Branch entities to coordinate their AI projects with the Cabinet, to include AI programmes in their multi-year, strategic and operational plans under Ministry of Economy guidance, and instructs the budget directorate (DIGEPRES) to fund prioritised ENIA projects.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Legal basis of the national AI strategy and the only binding instrument that imposes AI-specific coordination and planning duties on Executive Branch entities.
instruments.publisher_name: Government Office of Information and Communication Technologies

instruments.official_title: Estrategia Nacional de Inteligencia Artificial de la República Dominicana
instruments.english_title: National Artificial Intelligence Strategy of the Dominican Republic (ENIA)
instruments.issuing_authority: Innovation and Digital Development Cabinet (Gabinete de Innovación y Desarrollo Digital), technical coordination by the Government Office of Information and Communication Technologies (OGTIC)
instruments.current_status: Presented by President Luis Abinader, the Innovation Cabinet and OGTIC on 11 October 2023 and approved by Decree 498-23 of the same date, which keeps it valid until 31 December 2030; the 107-page document carries no printed date and is published on the Agenda Digital platform, which Decree 498-23 (art. 3) names as where the ENIA and its action plan must be available. Several of its regulatory actions (update of Law 172-13, a national AI sandbox committee, an AI ethics code) had not produced an adopted official document as of 2026-10-12 (see leads).
instruments.summary: The Dominican Republic's first national AI strategy, built around Smart Government, a Human Talent and Innovation Hub, a Data Hub and a cross-cutting regional pillar, with an action plan assigning lead and partner institutions and timelines to 2030, a financing chapter and monitoring indicators. Under governance and ethics it commits to creating a Directorate General of Innovation and Digital Development, updating data protection Law 172-13 with AI safeguards and a data protection authority, setting up a national committee to assess and promote AI regulatory sandboxes, and developing an AI ethics code that would require informing citizens when AI profiles or decides about them in public services. It also sets objectives for an AI governance framework and civil-servant training in public administration, AI in education and the labour market, and high-performance computing infrastructure.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Current national AI strategy; sets the government's AI governance, ethics and public-sector AI agenda.
instruments.evidence_reference: curl (browser user agent, --max-time 90): full 107-page PDF read (pdftotext) from the Agenda Digital platform (agendadigital.gob.do, listed in its media library as Final_ENIA); identical text to an OGTIC-hosted copy; launch date 11 October 2023 from OGTIC's launch notice and the Presidency notice. Status note: Date from the OGTIC launch notice; the document carries no printed publication date, so the date is taken from the issuer's launch notice. instruments.official_title: Ley núm. 172-13 que tiene por objeto la protección integral de los datos personales asentados en archivos, registros públicos, bancos de datos u otros medios técnicos de tratamiento de datos destinados a dar informes, sean estos públicos o privados
instruments.english_title: Law No. 172-13 on the comprehensive protection of personal data held in files, public registers, databases or other technical data-processing means intended to provide reports, whether public or private
instruments.current_status: Promulgated 13 December 2013 and published in Gaceta Oficial No. 10737 of 15 December 2013 (both stated on the text). In force; the National AI Strategy (2023) plans its update with AI safeguards and a data protection authority, and amendment bills have been studied in the Senate, but no amending law was found. The copy read is the text hosted by OGTIC, which reproduces the gazette reference. The law has no general data protection authority; the Superintendency of Banks supervises credit information companies.
instruments.summary: The general personal data protection law, covering personal data in public and private files and databases processed by automated or non-automated means. It sets processing principles, consent rules and the rights of access, rectification, cancellation and opposition, rules on sensitive data and on profiling for advertising (art. 71), and a detailed regime for credit information companies (including credit scoring defined as probabilistic and econometric models processed by specialised software) supervised by the Superintendency of Banks. It contains no AI-specific provisions but governs personal data used to train and run AI systems.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Main binding rule on personal data used by AI systems; the ENIA targets it for an AI-oriented update.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: Official gazette copies, congressional sites, the government information and communications technology office, the Digital Agenda platform, the Presidency, ministries and regulators were searched at national level. No qualifying AI-governance document was found for risk and assurance, procurement, cybersecurity, transparency, standards, sandboxes, readiness indices, sector rules, generative AI, drafts and consultations, international agreements, or past instruments. The gazette search interface and the Senate and Chamber bill pages were not checked directly, a 2026 decree on data interoperability is available only as a scanned image, and the pending AI bills and the announced AI ethics code remain leads to check later.
coverage_audit.technical_note: Coverage note (original): Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-12, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. consultoria.gov.do search interface not used; senadord.gob.do and camaradediputados.gob.do bill pages not reached (Chamber agenda download error). Decree 403-2026 (data interoperability) scanned, not checked. Decree 498-23 source: signed scan on OGTIC (no G.O. number printed). ENIA undated; 2023-10-11 from OGTIC launch notice (matches decree). Law 172-13 from OGTIC copy reproducing G.O. 10737. Agenda Digital 2030 (Decree 527-21) AI in passing; Penal Code Law 74-25 art. 192 technology-neutral (leads). NORTIC A7/A8/A9:2025: no AI. Convention 108: not a party. Units covered: Law: Gazette copies via state hosts (OGTIC, DGII) and congressional sites searched for AI: no AI-specific law; Decree 498-23 (ENIA) recorded; Law 172-13 (data protection) recorded; Penal Code 74-25 checked (technology-neutral montage offence, lead); AI bills in both chambers pending (leads, not verified on official portals). consultoria.gov.do own search not used (texts found on other official hosts).; Government: OGTIC (posts and media library), Agenda Digital platform, Presidency: ENIA recorded; AI ethics code in drafting (lead); Agenda Digital 2030 mentions AI only in passing (lead); NORTIC A7/A8/A9:2025 (security, cybersecurity, risk) checked, no AI content; Decree 403-2026 on data interoperability/governance is a scan without text layer, not checked for AI.; Ministries: Education (MINERD/MESCyT), justice (Poder Judicial), health, MAP: searched, no AI policy or guidance document found.; Regulators: No data protection authority exists (Superintendency of Banks supervises credit bureaus); Superintendency of Banks, Central Bank, INDOTEL, CNCS (cybersecurity), DIGEIG: searched, no AI-specific document found.. Not reached: consultoria.gov.do gazette search interface (not queried directly); senadord.gob.do / camaradediputados.gob.do legislative tracking (bill texts not read); Decree 403-2026 full text (scanned, no OCR). Could not verify: AI bills in the Chamber of Deputies and Senate (official download link broken; Senate not checked directly); Estado del Ecosistema de IA report (404); Adoption of the AI Code of Ethics announced for mid-2026. risk-assurance, procurement, cyber-security, transparency, standards, sandbox, index-readiness, sectoral, generative-ai, drafts, international, historical: no material found.

leads.title: Ley núm. 74-25, Orgánica que instituye el Código Penal (art. 192, montajes)
leads.english_title: Organic Law No. 74-25 instituting the Penal Code (art. 192 on false or altered images, audio or video)
leads.note: Consolidated Gaceta Oficial special edition No. 11257 (14 Aug 2026) hosted by DGII. Art. 192 (as amended by Law 44-26) punishes creating or spreading false or altered images, video or audio 'por medio de montajes o por cualquier otra forma' without consent; technology-neutral, no explicit AI mention, so not recorded (relevant to deepfakes).
